pages.text: $(bold)Tier 2 reached.$() The mid-tier frontiers are open to you.$(br)$(li)$(bold)Dimensions:$() the Twilight Forest and Blue Skies (Everbright and Everdawn).$(li)$(bold)Tech:$() the Thermal Series and basic Industrial Foregoing.$(li)$(bold)Magic:$() Ars Nouveau.$(li)$(bold)Gear:$() Steel, Manasteel, Steeleaf and Fiery, plus Simply Swords uniques from Twilight bosses (the first ones drop from Tier 1 bosses).

pages.title: What's Next
pages.text: To reach $(t3)Tier 3$(), bank $(t3){{tier 2 threshold}}$() tokens or clear $(t3){{tier 2 rushpct}}$() of the Tier 2 bosses.$(br2)Track it with $(l:icraft:progression/check_your_standing)Check Your Standing$(/l). $(note)Diamonds are still a Tier 3 material, not yet in worldgen or chests.$()
